svg.title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer v1.1.0 · Figure 3 · The Normal Form And The Host, Proved
svg.text: FIGURE 3
THE NORMAL FORM AND THE HOST, PROVED
BIRCH AND SWINNERTON-DYER · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
THE NORMAL FORM · THE RECORD, THE TRANSFER, THE VALUE
THE RECORD
The registration keeps every curve, its order
and its coefficient bit, and registers the curve's
rank at its order: on the record the rank sits on
the seat.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE TRANSFER · THE ONE BIT
The value of a frame is exactly the transfer of
the value from its record to the frame: the
antecedent a theorem, the implication the
whole content.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: THE VALUE
At every host the value of the host's frame is
the host's sentence, rank equal to order at
every curve, by theorem: the sentence is the
bit.

svg.text: WHAT THE NORMAL FORM PROVES ON THE ROW, WITH NO PREMISE
The bit is the act
The transfer holds exactly when the act stands.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Self-recursion
The record is self-recursive with no premise; the
frame exactly when it carries the value.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The bit is keyed
The transfer holds on the calm frame and fails on
the counter frame.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The record decides nothing
Two coherent frames share a record and split on the
value; no principle true of every record decides it.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Every route passes the bit
Any premise that yields the value yields the
transfer, in any vocabulary.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: No uniform answer
Across the frames of the row the transfer is neither
always true nor always false.

svg.text: THE HOST AND THE BINDING, PROVED · PART B OF THE MASTER AND THE MATHLIB BINDING
The binding is a theorem
The value of the host's frame is exactly the host's
sentence; the order is read off the expansion
uniquely.

svg.text: The sign fixes the parity
At every curve the sign fixes the parity of the order;
a minus sign forces the central value to vanish.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The parity of the rank
Under the sentence the sign fixes the parity of the
rank, and a minus sign forces positive rank.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Bound to Mathlib's curves
The rank is Module.finrank ℤ of the library's group
of rational points; the kernel's value is the rank
statement.
